audit.whatIsWrong: The page calls this EVEN at 5.5/10 while the data says 44.46% over 551 games, and level 6 disagreed with the already-audited mirror (nasus__locke set level 6 to Locke).
audit.why: A 44% matchup is not even, and the two directions must give the same answer for Level 6. Mirror findings state Purgatory makes level 6 Locke's stage; my page said Skill.
audit.corrected: diff EVEN -> HARD, diffRating 5.5/10 -> 6.5/10, carryRating 6/10 -> 7/10, and phases[4].side + win[4] Skill -> Locke as a matched pair with whys[4] rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] said Fury of the Sands brings 'no lane-ending threat, still skill', which contradicts the mirror's level-6 finding.
audit.why: Fury of the Sands raises his health and resistances, but Purgatory executes on a health threshold — resistances do not move that floor. That is why 6 is Locke's stage and 2+ items is his.
audit.corrected: whys[4] now states the execute-vs-bulk point; late-game ownership left with Nasus, matching packet and mirror.

audit.whatIsWrong: Wither is repeatedly labelled '(E)'. Per the kit, Wither is his W (700 range, 15/14/13/12/11s); his E is Spirit Fire, a zone that reduces Armor.
audit.why: A player who reads '(E)' watches the wrong button and mis-tracks the one cooldown that decides whether Ashen Pursuit gets him out. Wither cuts Move Speed and Attack Speed — it does not stop the dash itself, but it makes the exit useless.
audit.corrected: mid and spikes[3].text now say Wither (W) with its 700 range and 15s rank-1 cooldown; report[5].t and dosFull[0].d carry the same numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldown numbers on the matchup-defining button.
audit.why: Wither's 15s at rank 1 against Ashen Pursuit's flat 10s is the whole trading clock.
audit.corrected: Both numbers now appear in mid, report[5].t and dosFull[0].d.
